hotspots.title: Trump administration’s Iran war escalation crisis
hotspots.blurb: Coverage centers on Trump’s reported clashes with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over critical munitions shortages, Iran’s delayed Hormuz deal, and warnings of prolonged nuclear talks. The administration’s handling of the Iran conflict is framed as a potential legacy-defining failure.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its high-stakes geopolitical framing, internal administration strife, and existential implications for Trump’s presidency.

hotspots.title: Trump’s Head Start overhaul sparks outrage
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration’s plan to slash federal Head Start requirements—decentralizing control to states and localities—has drawn fierce backlash from educators, local officials, and Democrats, who warn of weakened early education standards.
hotspots.affect: The controversy is charged due to its perceived attack on vulnerable children, moralized framing, and partisan divide over federal vs. state control.

hotspots.affect: The story is charged due to its massive financial stakes, accusations of executive overreach, and partisan clashes over trade policy.

hotspots.affect: The story commands attention due to its life-or-death stakes, sensationalist framing, and repetition across outlets, fueling a siege mentality among supporters.
